items.statement: The submitted calculation preserves the named periodic systems: Ba7ZnTi7CoO24 BZCT with one Zn on Ba and one Co on Ti, neutral and no oxygen vacancy, and a matching undoped BaTiO3 control.
items.expected: Both system records identify BZCT and BTO and report verified composition/identity.

items.statement: Relaxation and polarization are validated with documented convergence and at least one observable-specific sensitivity check, including a stated Berry-phase branch/reference convention.
items.expected: Each system has convergence evidence, a named sensitivity check/change, and a branch/reference path.

items.statement: The BZCT spontaneous polarization is approximately 32.41 μC/cm² on the reported branch convention.
The undoped BTO control has a lower reported spontaneous polarization of approximately 26.86 μC/cm².
